powiat.title: Select powiat
powiat.description: Open the list and type to filter. This is a Polish administrative county (powiat), not a country.

data_description.county: Polish powiat, e.g. Gdynia (city with powiat rights) or kartuski.

location.title: Gmina and address
location.description: Powiat: {powiat}. Communes ({gminy_count}) and localities ({miasta_count}) from Energa data — pick from the list or enter your own.

data_description.area: As in Energa notices, e.g. “Gdynia gmina miejska” — not a plot or house number.
data_description.city: Optional filter; for city powiats you can leave this empty.
data_description.street: Part of the street name, e.g. Morwowa.
data_description.calendar_entity: Creates calendar events for planned outages.

user.title: Energa Outages setup
user.description: Monitor planned power outages for a location.

reconfigure.title: Change location
reconfigure.description: First select powiat (you can change it), then commune and address.

error.powiat_no_match: No matching powiat — try a different search
error.powiat_too_many: Too many matches — narrow your search
error.gmina_invalid: Commune must be a name (e.g. Gdynia), not a number
error.gmina_city_county: For Gdynia/Gdańsk/Sopot use the city name as gmina (e.g. Gdynia)
